Introduction

Zhou Jie Qiong (formerly known as Kyulkyung) is a Chinese dancer, singer-songwriter, composer, and actress under Zhou Jieqiong Studio. She is a former member of the girl group PRISTIN, its sub-unit PRISTIN V, and the project girl group I.O.I.

In 2016, Zhou Jie Qieong participated in Mnet's survival television show, Produce 101, along with five other trainees from her agency at the time, Pledis Entertainment. She ranked 6th overall, qualifying to be a member of the final group I.O.I. She debuted as a member of the group on May 4, 2016, with the release of the mini album 'Chrysalis', and was active with them throughout the entire length of their activities. I.O.I released their last song, "DOWNPOUR", on January 18, 2017, and held a concert from January 20 to 22, before eventually disbanding on January 29, 2017.

On May 4, 2016, she debuted in I.O.I with the mini album, Chrysalis, and its title track, "Dream Girls".

After the disbandment of I.O.I, Zhou Jie Qieong, along fellow labelmate and I.O.I member Lim Nayoung, debuted as a member of Pledis Entertainment's girl group PRISTIN, which debuted on March 21, 2017, with the mini album "Hi! PRISTIN" and its title track, "Wee Woo". The agency then formed PRISTIN V, a sub-unit of the group, with Zhou Jie Qieong being one of its members. They debuted on May 28, 2018, with the single album, "Like a V". Both group eventually disbanded in 2019 after almost two years without activity.

Zhou Jie Qieong made her solo China-based debut with the digital single "Why" on September 6, 2018.

On September 2019, Zhou Jie Qiong sent a contract termination notice to Pledis and XCSS Entertainment, her Chinese agency, which led them to demand her for breaching the contract on March 25, 2020, declaring the notice as "baseless". The same day Zhou Jie Qiong released a statement on her Weibo.

Since then, she has been promoting as an actress in China and is well-known for the dramas Miss Truth (2020), Legend of Fei (2020), To Be With You (2021) and Be My Princess (2021).
